correctness.rationale: Every unital endomorphism is uniquely (P,Q) since cubic monomials vanish; the degree-two action is Sym²P. Squaring gives exact identities P²=P and Q=QP+Sym²P Q. For projection P, the quadratic constraints split independently on U and T, proving all fiber dimensions. Every image has a unique graph parametrization modulo Sym²U; direct complement counting proves both finite-field spectra and per-image multiplicities in every characteristic. The constant-rank geometric bundles follow from the projection/Grassmannian bases. Exhaustive independent small-field tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The full cube-zero truncated symmetric algebra is the natural universal commutative short local algebra with unrestricted quadratic products. Classifying its complete retraction monoid and embedded retract images with distinct Gaussian enumerators is a motivated structural and arithmetic invariant for all embedding dimensions, rather than a chosen numerical slice or automatic single example. Moduli and finite-field multiplicities distinguish map counts from subalgebra counts.
